note: These are proposed requirements. No implementation or benchmark execution is claimed. Phase IDs and test IDs are separate namespaces.

invariants.invariant: Exactly one persistent main shell and one workbench presentation host per main renderer epoch.
A route change is not a close-session, kill-terminal, stop-agent, or stop-server request.
Resident workbench component keys never include pathname, navigation ID, timestamps, display name, or mutable session snapshot objects.
Retained children cannot derive their identity from current router params or another session's active context.
Every mutation carries concrete validated project/workspace/lane identity and expected binding revision. No `unbound` or guessed-lane writes.
One in-flight request per renderer resource owner and key/generation, shared by prefetch and mounted consumers.
Superseded renderer epochs, navigation commands, invalidated resource generations, and old binding revisions cannot activate or overwrite current state.

No synchronous localStorage reads/writes or whole-collection JSON serialization on ordinary navigation/layout lookup/store-update paths covered by this plan. One-time migration is explicitly separate.
No synchronous session-registry filesystem operations on main-process activation paths.
Persisted `null`/not-found/denied outcomes are not replaced by stale successful cached data.
Hidden presentation does not imply stopped services; running services do not imply visible presentation.
Hidden workbenches receive no continuous presentation animation, layout, fit, focus, or DOM measurement work after deactivation settles.
A view eviction cannot destroy uncaptured drafts, local edits, or the state necessary to restore a supported widget.
Inactive session changes cannot replace the current header, open a global dialog, steal focus, or publish native overlay bounds.
Runtime service authority and presentation residency have distinct policies; neither silently overrides the other's explicit leases.
Metrics distinguish scheduled frame callbacks, content readiness, and trace-confirmed visual presentation.
Required tests fail or report blocked when their fixture/capability is missing; they never silently skip to a passing verdict.
Final default execution has no old/new dual writers, dual refresh loops, or dual activation paths.

phases.title: Add counters and correct regression scenarios
Freeze shared contracts and the resource engine
Implement worker persistence and migration infrastructure
Replace session activation and registry hot-path I/O
Cut over renderer persistence and hydration
Extract stable shell and retained session boundary
Remove old paths and enforce boundaries

tests.scenario: Two subscribers and prefetch request same unresolved workspace key.
tests.required_assertion: Exactly one underlying resolve call; all receive the same current-generation outcome.

tests.scenario: Resolve prefetch after the destination mounts.
tests.required_assertion: No second mounted-hook request.

tests.scenario: Invalidate while old request runs; start new request; resolve old last.
tests.required_assertion: Old result cannot publish or clear the new in-flight promise.

tests.scenario: Cached ready entry, background refresh fails.
tests.required_assertion: Cached display survives; error is visible as refresh state, not empty data.

tests.scenario: Authoritative null/denied follows cached project.
tests.required_assertion: Cached success is no longer exposed as current authorized project.

tests.scenario: Change preferred workspace, repository expectation, or binding revision.
tests.required_assertion: Different correct key/invalidation; no incorrect cache hit.

tests.scenario: Expand sidebar and foreground workbench for same resource.
tests.required_assertion: One reconciliation operation per interval.

tests.scenario: Minimize then resume window.
tests.required_assertion: View-driven polling pauses; one shared resume refresh per stale key.

tests.scenario: Many catalog subscribers mount before initial fetch resolves.
tests.required_assertion: One listener and one initial request.

tests.scenario: Catalog push revision 12 precedes initial fetch revision 11.
tests.required_assertion: Revision 12 remains; unchanged entries retain stable references.

tests.scenario: A→B→C with deferred prerequisites resolved in reverse order.
tests.required_assertion: Only C foreground; A/B may populate only their still-valid resource entries.

tests.scenario: Same href with new create-tile intent vs no-op click.
tests.required_assertion: New command consumed once; no-op produces no transaction.

tests.scenario: Back/Forward/direct link/native menu.
tests.required_assertion: One accepted intent and one correct route outcome per interaction; no second history stack.

tests.scenario: Router transition cancelled/blocked.
tests.required_assertion: Pending feedback clears; previous accepted surface stays authoritative.

tests.scenario: Hover/focus over projects.
tests.required_assertion: No create/attach/checkout/activate/terminal/server/agent side effect.

tests.scenario: Branch status unresolved with no trusted stored knowledge.
tests.required_assertion: No invented collab lane/model write; typed pending/error outcome.

tests.scenario: A→Store→A through actual sidebar controls.
tests.required_assertion: Same shell/host/Dockview IDs; A's focus/scroll/layout retained; no new terminal instance.

tests.scenario: A→Inbox→A and A→Tasks→A.
tests.required_assertion: Same retained instance guarantee; verify actual route/page visited.

tests.scenario: A→B→A, distinct project text and workspaces.
tests.required_assertion: Correct project scope, header, editor, terminal, and native preview; no context leakage.

tests.scenario: Same tile twice, then another tile in A.
tests.required_assertion: No router round trips or activation for same-workbench tile focus.

tests.scenario: Hide A while B becomes visible.
tests.required_assertion: A inert; no hidden portal/dialog, keyboard handler, header publication, or focus steal.

tests.scenario: Resize window while A hidden, then return.
tests.required_assertion: No hidden fit/layout; one necessary activation reconciliation; nonzero dimensions and preserved ratios.

tests.scenario: Hide/show without resize.
tests.required_assertion: No unnecessary layout reconstruction or geometry drift.

tests.scenario: Agent synthetic stream continues in hidden A.
tests.required_assertion: Canonical output advances; hidden animation/measurement does not; returning shows current output.

tests.scenario: Terminal emits while hidden/evicted.
tests.required_assertion: Process/output semantics preserved; no unbounded detached listener growth.

tests.scenario: Browser tile hidden under ordinary route/settings overlay.
tests.required_assertion: Native surface not visible/intercepting input; correct surface reappears on return.

tests.scenario: Visit D with A/B/C resident.
tests.required_assertion: Oldest ordinary inactive unpinned view evicted; active view never selected for eviction.

tests.scenario: Evict then reopen a view with edits/draft/selection/scroll.
tests.required_assertion: Data and supported view state recovered; runtime not closed by eviction.

tests.scenario: Keep a popout from A open and navigate parent to B.
tests.required_assertion: Popout stays on A; parent does not steal it; explicit close releases pin.

tests.scenario: Project settings and task overlay intent.
tests.required_assertion: Exactly one active overlay; hidden sessions do not consume it.

tests.scenario: Cold initial scope hydrates persisted model slowly.
tests.required_assertion: No empty default persisted before hydration; queued tile intent executes once afterward.

tests.scenario: Authoritative project removal during pending switch.
tests.required_assertion: Target cannot activate; private stale UI removed without deleting local files.

tests.scenario: Settings-only window start/restart.
tests.required_assertion: No main host or main foreground lease created.

tests.scenario: StrictMode/HMR mount-cleanup replay in development.
tests.required_assertion: No permanent duplicate bridge/listener/epoch/lease; production IDs stable across navigation.

tests.scenario: Hold IME composition or unsaved editor state during eviction pressure.
tests.required_assertion: Capture safely or block eviction; no lost input.

tests.scenario: Hidden interval with theme change.
tests.required_assertion: At most necessary one-time update, no recurring fit/animation/poll loop afterward.

tests.scenario: Main accepts sequence 2 while sequence 1 prerequisite is delayed.
tests.required_assertion: Sequence 1 cannot later activate or reveal native surfaces.

tests.scenario: Retry same sequence/payload.
tests.required_assertion: Idempotent result, no duplicate activation/persistence.

tests.scenario: Same sequence with different payload, retired epoch, wrong sender.
tests.required_assertion: Rejected without mutation.

tests.scenario: Renderer reload/crash.
tests.required_assertion: Old epoch invalid; presentation leases released; no late focus/activation.

tests.scenario: Explicit session key for another workspace.
tests.required_assertion: Rejected; no latest-project/lane fallback for concrete navigation identity.

tests.scenario: Explicit close/delete races delayed activation.
tests.required_assertion: Closed/invalid generation cannot be revived by the delayed request.

tests.scenario: Ordinary view evicted while terminal/dev server/agent work runs.
tests.required_assertion: No close/kill/stop from eviction.

tests.scenario: Background policy sweep while UI/native surface held by lease.
tests.required_assertion: No silent release of a still-required presentation/service surface.

tests.scenario: Main activation with synchronous fs methods instrumented to fail.
tests.required_assertion: Navigation/session persistence path performs no sync filesystem operation.

tests.scenario: Many state changes inside debounce interval.
tests.required_assertion: Latest snapshot committed; serialization once per selected dirty record/flush, not each event.

tests.scenario: Slow revision 5 write finishes after revision 6 is queued.
tests.required_assertion: File cannot end at revision 5 after revision 6 commits.

tests.scenario: Storage write/rename/worker failure.
tests.required_assertion: Old valid record survives; flush reports failure; dirty state retained for retry.

tests.scenario: Crash before migration marker, restart import.
tests.required_assertion: Idempotent import, no duplicate/reset/overwrite of newer v2 state.

tests.scenario: Corrupt legacy record and valid neighboring record.
tests.required_assertion: Corrupt source preserved/quarantined; valid record imported; no destructive clear.

tests.scenario: Layout reset races pending old layout write.
tests.required_assertion: Old reset-key snapshot cannot overwrite reset/new layout.

tests.scenario: Hydration resolves after local/current-generation state changed.
tests.required_assertion: Older snapshot ignored; no stale replacement.

tests.scenario: Scoped query cache across account/deployment change.
tests.required_assertion: No prior identity data leak; authoritative null wins.

tests.scenario: Normal quit with pending writes.
tests.required_assertion: Close awaits actual commit revision or reports failure; enqueue alone is not success.

tests.scenario: Settings/secondary writer attempts stale model overwrite.
tests.required_assertion: Rejected/routed through canonical owner; main model preserved.

tests.scenario: Oversized query entry and large legitimate workbench state.
tests.required_assertion: Query entry not persisted beyond cap; user state preserved via supported chunking/recovery path.

tests.scenario: Resident A↔B 300 measured interactions.
tests.required_assertion: Warm budgets met; zero duplicate resolve/Git or widget recreation.

tests.scenario: A↔Store and A↔Inbox real route returns.
tests.required_assertion: Warm retention/latency gates; test records actual non-workbench page.

tests.scenario: No-hover cold project click and hover-immediate-click.
tests.required_assertion: Separate cache classes; cold shell remains responsive; in-flight dedup works.

tests.scenario: Rapid alternating inputs with delayed IPC/filesystem/query completion.
tests.required_assertion: Latest destination correct and responsive; no stale main activation.

tests.scenario: 100 cycles across eight projects plus ordinary pages.
tests.required_assertion: Ordinary residents bounded; listener/observer/lease counts return to expected bounds.

tests.scenario: Three populated retained views, one visible.
tests.required_assertion: Hidden steady-state counters meet budgets; active input does not depend on hidden presentation work.

tests.scenario: Populated query/layout/model persistence workload while switching.
tests.required_assertion: No renderer serialization/storage spikes on hot path; worker dispatch slice budget recorded.

tests.scenario: Packaged restart with migrated user-state fixture.
tests.required_assertion: Correct scoped restored layout/tiles; no terminal duplication or phantom workspace.

tests.scenario: Baseline/candidate memory sample after warmup and after stress cycles.
tests.required_assertion: Explain retained vs leaked resources; no monotonically growing live instance/listener counts. Heap/RSS reported, not treated as exact per-view accounting.

tests.scenario: Optimized production build with diagnostic code disabled.
tests.required_assertion: No test hooks/security weakening; smoke navigation still works.
